name: External Investigation Sub Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the investigation sub type, as published in an external investigation sub type code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

UTEX.name: Unable To Execute
UTEX.definition: Investigation relates to a transaction that cannot be executed.

FCCI.name: Financial Crime Compliance
FCCI.definition: Investigation relates to financial crimes compliance.

FWTR.name: Funds Wire Transfer Regulation
FWTR.definition: Investigation relates to funds/wire transfer regulation.

RQUF.name: Request Use Of Funds
RQUF.definition: Use of funds on an entry is requested.

RQDA.name: Request Debit Authorisation
RQDA.definition: Debit authorisation on an entry is requested.

RQVA.name: Request Value Date Adjustment
RQVA.definition: Revaluation of an entry is requested.

RQCH.name: Request Related To Charges
RQCH.definition: Investigation relating to charges that have been taken or are requested.
